messages:
maria_ae: Hey team — FinCo POC kickoff. Using this thread to align acceptance criteria, ops handoff, and cost guardrails.
ben_se: Quick context: two endpoints — abstractive summarization + search rescoring. Expected steady traffic ~200 rps, peak spikes ~800 during daily imports.
aj_devex: Got it. What do they want for latency / cost / quality targets?
maria_ae: Proposed acceptance targets: summarization p95 <= 350ms (up to 512 tokens), reranker p95 <= 120ms. Cost: target burn <= $3k/week for initial 4-week POC window (we have $4k/week contingency). Quality: offline eval pass rate >= 88% on curated prompt set; hallucination rate < 1.5%.
ben_se: Reasonable. Quick clarifying q's: 1) Acceptance path: offline eval only or also a live canary? 2) Security baseline: VPC + customer KMS required? 3) Any model family restrictions?
maria_ae: Acceptance = offline eval (1k labeled samples) + 1-week staging canary with sampled live traffic. Security = VPC + customer-managed KMS mandatory. No external network from model pods.
sam_ml: For the offline eval we should spell metrics: usefulness (1-5) mean >= 4.0, factuality spot-check failure rate < 2% across sample, reranker NDCG@10 >= 0.85. Also add semantic-similarity regression checks.
aj_devex: I'll draft the eval harness and prompt versioning. Proposed command to run baseline:
```bash
# run eval harness
python tools/run_eval.py --model redwood-13b-quant --prompts data/finco_eval.json \
  --metrics usefulness,factuality,ndcg --out results/finco_baseline.json
```
aj_devex: We'll store prompts + gold labels in prompts/finco/ and tag them in git. Want streaming on summary endpoint for acceptance?
ben_se: Streaming acceptable but note p95 must be measured as end-to-end completion. Streaming can add variability; recommend non-streaming for initial acceptance to keep SLO simple.
olivia_sre: Ops checklist: we need a runbook with healthchecks, rollback steps, throttle policies, and an on-call rotation for the canary. I can draft templates. Also confirm whether FinCo expects SOC2 artifacts for POC — that raises scope.
ci-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-blue -> canary-green 2026-05-12T03:00Z (automated note)
ben_se: Cost calc notes: avg summary ~250 tokens; at 200 rps that's ~5M tokens/day. I'll attach a calc sheet with token -> $ estimates and quantized vs full model deltas. Maria, please confirm committed weekly budget.
maria_ae: Confirmed up to $4k/week contingency. If burn trends >3.5k we'll enable stricter batching and fallback to quantized model.
sam_ml: Model plan: start with redwood-instruct-13B-quant for cost control; keep redwood-instruct-33B as quality fallback. We'll capture similarity-to-gold and hallucination flags for each batch.
aj_devex: Action items (owners + due dates):
- aj_devex: deliver eval harness + initial prompt set (due in 3 business days)
- sam_ml: baseline model + quantization profile + sample outputs (due in 5 business days)
- ben_se: cost spreadsheet + runbook skeleton PR (due in 2 business days)
- olivia_sre: on-call rota + rollback playbook draft (due in 4 business days)
- maria_ae: confirm labeled eval dataset delivery from FinCo (due EOD tomorrow)
ben_se: I'll also add a short acceptance checklist at the top of the runbook: metrics, dataset link, baseline artifact, rollback steps, and budget guardrails.
aj_devex: I'll include regen tests, hallucination detectors, and a baseline NDCG artifact requirement for PR merge.
olivia_sre: Note: if FinCo requests formal audit artifacts (SOC2/ISO), please flag immediately. That will require security & legal.
maria_ae: Will escalate if they ask. For now the POC scope excludes audits.
ben_se: Tentative schedule: runbook + eval ready by 2026-05-15; canary start target 2026-05-20. Does that timeline work?
sam_ml: Works for ML.
aj_devex: Works for DevEx.
olivia_sre: Ops good on timeline.
maria_ae: Great — I'll update the customer and post the dataset ETA here. Tagging FinCo contact when artifact arrives. :thumbsup:
ben_se: I'll open the PR for the runbook checklist and link the cost sheet.
aj_devex: Updating task board now. Will drop the eval harness link here when ready.
